db_instance.Notes: MultiAZ=true (to-be del TP). Subnets privadas RDS (lab 07-v2). Una base dw con schemas bronce + gold.

bronce.Purpose: Datos crudos: ETLs (ECS) escriben desde los data sources

gold.Purpose: Analytics / DW procesado: Lambda API solo lectura

master.Name: dw/rds-master
master.Description: Master de RDS tp-dw-db — solo bootstrap / admin

etl.Name: dw/rds-etl
etl.Description: Credencial ETL (ECS): escritura bronce + lectura/escritura gold

api.Name: dw/rds-api
api.Description: Credencial Lambda API: SELECT solo sobre schema gold

security_group.Name: sg-rds
security_group.Description: Reusa SG del lab 07-v2. Ingress 5432 desde sg-api y sg-ecs-etl.

db_subnet_group.Name: tp-rds-subnets
db_subnet_group.Description: DB subnet group Multi-AZ — private-rds-a / private-rds-b (lab 07-v2)

snapshot.Notes: pg_dump → PutObject a MinIO (:9000). create-db-snapshot en MiniStack. En AWS real: start-export-task al mismo bucket.

endpoints.Notes: MinIO = data lake S3. LocalStack = EC2/VPC/IAM (S3 LocalStack deshabilitado). MiniStack = RDS + Secrets DB.
